title: About 10 million people a day
lines: I analyzed discovery, search and ranking across a homepage used by about 10 million people daily.
Clickstream and experiments helped guide product and design decisions.

title: Recommendations from friends
lines: I led analytics for Friends Recommendation, looking at how friend activity influenced ordering behavior.

title: Giving meals another chance
lines: As lead product analyst, I worked on Food Rescue, which offers cancelled meals to nearby customers.
The project reported about 50% less food waste across India.
